data.name: Specter Inspector
data.detailed_description:
Specter Inspector is a training simulator that operates as pop up windows on YOUR desktop.

Specter Inspector teaches YOU how to overcome dangerous specters that now risk corrupting your device upon instillation. Three modules of training teach you to control the paranormal inspector known as Bobert, utilize your EMF device to detect and evade specters, use your battery powered EMP device to stun and surpass specters, all while navigating an increasingly dangerous graveyard.

Can you conquer each module? Or will your device succumb to corruption?



  • Three modules of content to discover: utilize different inspector tools and specter evasion techniques to overcome the graveyard!
  • Definitely no ethereal spirits or wayward specters that take possession of your device upon instillation.
  • DO NOT LET SPECTERS CORRUPT YOUR D̴̫͛E̶̺̐V̷͔̆I̵̹͂C̴̛̺Ê̸̬!̶̺͊ ̵̝͒D̸̹̑ä̷͍ṅ̶̙g̴̺̾ȅ̶͚r̶̼̄ó̶̼ư̶̫ṣ̶̂ ̸̫͂s̶̩͌p̶̙͑e̷͍̕c̸̫̾t̷͉̄e̵͇͊r̸̗̄s̷͓̏ ̶̿ͅm̴͉̕a̶͖͝y̸̢̓ ̷̨̀e̷̛̤s̴̮͂c̴̭͒a̷̠͠p̵͍̕ẽ̶̱



This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
